PROPOSAL — design-only. Not runtime verified. Built from existing tokens and components; nothing on pages 00–10 was changed.

1  Shell/Topbar, Shell/Rail, Shell/BottomBar, Shell/InspectorHeader are now components. Every v2 screen uses instances — fix once, every screen follows. (Audit #1)
2  One Inspector: the collapsible-section Style (63:6393 pattern) is canonical; header shrinks 112 → 84px by merging breakpoint + state into one control. (#2, #13)
3  Site didn’t load: Inspector visibly read-only, selection actions removed, save status says “Not loaded”, duplicate message removed. (#3)
4  One page switcher in the bottom bar replaces per-page tabs; scales to 100 pages; resource areas (CMS, Settings, Brand) show no page tabs. (#4)
5  Settings: no second Brand entry, no duplicate Danger zone heading, topbar Site settings stays active. (#5, #17)
6  Breakpoint switcher is icon-only with the active device highlighted. (#6)
7  Publish: one CTA (in the tray), warnings use the alert icon, canvas reflows beside the tray, legal links removed. (#8)
8  CMS: StatusBadge (Draft / Published / Changed since publish), AA contrast 6.87 / 4.75 / 8.69. (#9)
9  Layers: expanded rows show an open chevron, footer pinned, correct rail item active. (#10)
10 HYPOTHESIS first run (FR-01…03): template-or-blank start, one contextual tip, a dismissible 3-step checklist. Replace after the B9 interviews. (#12)

Deferred: two undo systems (#7 — needs an owner decision on area-scoped undo), Play flow names (#11), canvas label overlap (#14), toolbar baseline (#15), Brand density (#16), Pages footer actions (#18), class button gutter (#19), save copy (#20), and swapping the shell into all ~2,250 original frames.
Rollout into originals · 22 Oct 2026 (owner: “ek hi undo system”, apply shell)

Pages 03–07 and 09 now use Shell/Topbar (1,797 frames), Shell/BottomBar (1,855) and Shell/Rail (1,886).
One undo: Undo/Redo live only in the topbar. Canvas-toolbar undo hidden everywhere; Brand’s own Undo/Redo (142 buttons) hidden; 92 non-standard topbars (Publish states, narrow widths) got the same Undo group.
Prototype: 275 links moved to the new shell; 95 bottom-tab links collapsed onto the page switcher; per-tab and “scroll to last page” links that the switcher cannot represent stay on hidden “Legacy ·” layers.
Reversible: every replaced shell is kept hidden as “Legacy · …” in its frame. B7-RJ03 (area-scoped ⌘Z) is marked SUPERSEDED.
Follow-up: the last 35 page-tab bottom bars (1024–1920 px, CMS/Assets/Brand/Settings/Responsive) now use Shell/BottomBar; 359 original Inspector headers compacted 112 → 84 px (breakpoint line folded into the “Editing” select). Old bars and lines kept hidden as “Legacy · …”.
Minor fixes in originals 03–09: selection label 20→16 px so it no longer sits on the text above (#14); canvas breadcrumb centred with the toolbar (#15); Brand token rows 112→96 px, 520 wide, Edit beside the content (#16); duplicate “DANGER ZONE” heading hidden, group labels get 8 px air (#17); slug em dash removed, Add page full width (#18); “Open in Brand → Classes” has a 12 px gutter (#19); save pill reads “Saved just now” (#20); product bar says Details, not Scenarios (#11). Page switcher names the open page; count reads “5 pages · 1 template” to match the Pages panel. Not changed: “Review” vs “In review · 2” are two states, not a copy conflict.
Major fixes now in originals: #3 B7-G02 truly read-only (no Publish, dimmed Inspector, “View only until the site loads”, “Not loaded · nothing saved yet”); #8 23 Publish-tray frames — canvas fits beside the tray, one CTA in the tray; #9 450 CMS statuses → StatusBadge (Success/Neutral/Warning); #6 893 breakpoint switchers icon-only with the real device highlighted; #5 460 Settings menus without the duplicate “Brand ↗”; #2 old Inspector body aligned to the canonical one (chevrons on collapsed rows, Background, ColorControl swatch, compact header) — the 129 Inspector spec boards keep their property behaviour; #10 Layers rows: open chevron where children show, page root uses the file icon without a chevron. Topbar copy: “Request review” / “In review · N open”. Not changed: hidden Legacy layers (owner decision).
Prototype walkthrough (flow-audit): Play journeys F1–F5 click through start → finish; page 09 is 100% reachable, 0 dead ends, 0 dangling links. 47 links that hid with today’s fixes were re-attached (Settings → Brand on the rail, scenario hub on Details, Undo on the topbar). New: F6 “Site didn’t load → Retry” on page 07 (G02 → G01 → C07); topbar Publish → F4.01 and Preview → F1.11 on every Play frame; responsive boards moved to a “Reference” section; page-switcher dropdown component Shell/PageSwitcherMenu (558:4419) wired as an overlay in the offline flow (B3-P28/31/39); note on page 06 that Publish boards are spec only. Left by design: CMS frames have no page switcher (B3-P88 About tab link).
